recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the core build stops using the fixed Kindling behavior or if a future rendered-build check again finds datatypes-definitions.html targets for datatypes with dedicated definition pages.
issue_request: FHIR-33207 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and reported that datatype UML element links, such as ElementDefinition.constraint.expression from the ElementDefinition UML tab, incorrectly targeted datatypes-definitions.html instead of datatype-specific definitions pages such as elementdefinition-definitions.html; the Jira noted that larger datatypes such as Dosage appeared affected too.
initial_application: No FHIR-core source commit with FHIR-33207 was found because the SVG generator had already moved to the external HL7 Kindling dependency before the Jira was filed. HL7/kindling commit b501b047d5cc472e5be99ce938d202c5ff1972cd, titled 'FHIR-33207 Datatype UML links go to wrong page', changed SvgGenerator.baseUrl from hard-coded datatype/resource cases to definitions.getSrcFile(root)+"-definitions.html#" and stopped stripping datatype-relative links.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini keeps ElementDefinition and the Dosage-family datatypes active and maps them to dedicated type pages. The active ElementDefinition and Dosage pages invoke datatype rendering through [%dt ...%] includes, and build.gradle.kts/gradle.properties configure the build to use Kindling 1.25.5-SNAPSHOT. R5 published pages and current build.fhir.org pages both show correct SVG xlink targets for the ElementDefinition and Dosage examples, with no datatypes-definitions.html targets for those cases.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current authoritative source and external generator already satisfy the issue. No source files were changed.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue in the datatype UML link family; it concerned the Element class-title hyperlink rather than FHIR-33207's datatype element definition links and was already represented on the combined branch.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive R5 technical correction reporting datatype UML element links that pointed to datatypes-definitions.html instead of datatype-specific definitions pages.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final issue request and the expected target pattern for ElementDefinition and similar larger datatypes.

evidence_items.summary: Rik Smithies noted that ElementDefinition UML links were broken and referenced FHIR#33207 after trying to find ElementDefinition.constraint.expression documentation.
evidence_items.learned: This corroborates the user-facing broken-link workflow behind the Jira report.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I minutes list FHIR-33207 as a technical correction that will be fixed, noting it may be a tooling issue.
evidence_items.learned: This confirms work-group disposition and supports interpreting the implementation as a tooling fix.

evidence_items.summary: ElementDefinition and Dosage-family datatypes are active, mapped to dedicated type pages, and rendered through datatype template includes.
evidence_items.learned: The affected artifacts are in current build scope and the source mapping provides the dedicated page names needed by the generator.

evidence_items.summary: Kindling commit 'FHIR-33207 Datatype UML links go to wrong page' changed SvgGenerator.baseUrl to return definitions.getSrcFile(root)+"-definitions.html#".
evidence_items.learned: The issue was applied in the external generator used by the core build rather than through a FHIR-core source page edit.

evidence_items.summary: Current Kindling addAttribute/baseUrl still constructs UML element xlink targets from definitions.getSrcFile(root), and Definitions.getSrcFile checks typePages before falling back to datatypes.
evidence_items.learned: The current generator retains the behavior needed for dedicated datatype definition pages.

evidence_items.locator: Rendered R5 and current build UML link checks
evidence_items.command: Python urllib checks of https://hl7.org/fhir/R5/elementdefinition.html, https://hl7.org/fhir/R5/dosage.html, https://build.fhir.org/elementdefinition.html, and https://build.fhir.org/dosage.html for SVG xlink targets
evidence_items.summary: The checks found correct elementdefinition-definitions.html and dosage-definitions.html SVG targets and zero datatypes-definitions.html targets for the ElementDefinition and Dosage examples.
evidence_items.learned: Both the applied-for R5 publication and current CI publication surfaces satisfy the Jira request.
